motion_rule: she rides a wet sheet slung on the pulley line, hauled right to left all clip, and never perches; the yard, roofs and washing sweep past the lens every beat; the camera tracks alongside at her eye level; new shot size each beat, her head never smaller than a third of the frame, one action per beat
character: a slim grey turtle dove, pink breast, black neck ring, head stabbing the air
second_characters: A SWARM of crows crossing the lens, two of them in flat caps riding the line beside her with knives
props: ONE coin purse tied to her toe, tumbling along the line beside her; ONE rolled banknote
prop_continuity: the purse rolls along the line with her and never hangs still; a crow takes the banknote at 1.65; the purse is slit at 6.25, empty from 7.85
environment: yards packed with washing lines, wet sheets and pillowcases ripping past the lens a wing away, roofs and chimneys behind
light_events: storm light, the yard still bright, white sheets blazing, lightning behind her at 4.30 and 7.25

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: soft cooing female voice gone hard, preaching, biting each word, 4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ot-LO-zhish, CHOR-ny, pri-DYOT, CHOR-na-ya, DEN-gi, spa-SUT, TOL-ko, KRY-lya
audio.pacing: 0.95-2.70, 3.10-4.65 and 5.05-7.25 each one breath; after 7.25 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her beak opens wide and shapes every syllable, throat swelling
audio.sfx: pulley squealing, sheets cracking, wingbeats, crow calls, coins ringing

timeline.a: the sheet slams off along the line, the whole yard tearing past
A SWARM rips past the lens the other way, raking the washing
she rides on, ONE rolled banknote in her beak, roofs ripping past
a crow swoops alongside and plucks the banknote from her beak on the move
she snaps after it and the sheet swings her round, washing raking past
A SWARM comes as a wall at the lens, the line hauling her through them
two crows in flat caps drop on the line beside her and ride along, knives out
she shoulders past them down the line, the purse tumbling after her, chimneys ripping past
ONE crow knocks her wing at the lens and she reels sideways along the line
she catches the line again, the purse swinging out past the lens
she kicks the purse and sprays coins back at the crows
the crows wheel onto the coins and catch them at the lens, yard tearing past
a crow slits the purse open on the move, coins pouring out along the line
she throws her wings wide and the line rips her out from under them
she dives at the camera and fills the lens, wings hammering, beak snapping
she tears the empty purse off her toe and hurls it past the lens
A SWARM hauls her coins across the lens, she tearing after them
she flies straight at the lens over the roofs, the crows falling behind

must_appear: every word is spoken, the last by 7.25; she rides the moving line all clip and it never stops; the purse never hangs still; crows are on her in every beat, at her side or across the lens; at 7.25 she fills the lens head-on, wings hammering, alive and furious; the crows carry her coins off
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, cyrillic letters, digits, a perched hero, a sack hanging still, a still yard, an empty yard, a parked camera, a wide shot, slow motion, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, floating objects
